topic: Updating facility data and reporting logic
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several technical updates. First, a new SL (Service Level) was assigned and updated for facility 4119 (WoCo_NatGallery_Cafe), requiring promotion from staging to production.

Second, issues were addressed regarding data extraction for locations without sensors. It was determined that the reporting tool's default dataset change caused empty reports because it failed to account for facilities lacking sensor data. To fix this, a mechanism was implemented to create 'dummy sensors' for these locations, ensuring they appear in the report even if no data is present.

Finally, discussions clarified the technical process of updating dictionaries (in ClickHouse) and the flow of aggregated data from ML staging tables.
decisions: The new SL=58 was to be promoted for facility 4119 (WoCo_NatGallery_Cafe) from staging to production.
A fix was implemented in the reporting tool to ensure locations without sensors are displayed, even if no data is available.
action_items: The new SL=58 for facility 4119 (WoCo_NatGallery_Cafe) needs to be loaded into production and subsequently calculated.
Monitoring the stability of dictionary updates across multiple servers was discussed, noting that waiting for natural reload is safer than forced reloading.
